params.entry: taker buy at the first Coinbase print >= release + delta, x (1 + max(1.5 x half-spread, 2 bp)) + taker fee
params.exit: market sale at the first print >= entry + H, worse by the same half-spread charge, + taker fee
params.half_spread: median |buyer - seller-initiated| / 2 of adjacent opposite-aggressor prints in the 10 min before (fallbacks: 60 min <=10 s gaps, 60 min any gap, 50 bp)
params.size: min($5K, 1% of trailing 30-day median daily USD volume); open notional <= sleeve capital
params.universe: Binance catalog-48 titles classified by scripts/hunt/h5an/events.py (commit c7d89c5); ticker on Coinbase USD spot with trades in the hour before releaseDate

selection_rule: highest DEV alpha t (sleeve $30K at 2x costs on the incumbent at $70K) among trials with >= 20 trades; ties to the simpler variant
fade_variant: not run: 0 DEV events had a Coinbase perp live at releaseDate (needs >= 20)
